verdict.rationale: Orama is an in-memory/browser-native search engine with a documented fast, synchronous search API, and a runtime probe confirms a full create→insert→search cycle executes entirely in-process with typo-tolerant matching, consistent with keystroke-speed lookups; docs also emphasize quick insertion and rich full-text/typo-tolerant search suited to live search UIs. Missing for 10: explicit as-you-type/debounce UI example and published millisecond latency benchmarks under load.
